name: Streaming grid
description: World streaming's test scene (p353): a 1 km square cut into 16 × 16 cells of 64 m, each a procedural terrain block with scattered rocks and crates registered as code content. The camera flies across it and the cells around it load and unload; the scene's debug tab switches to hovering on a cell boundary, and the Streaming tab's overlay shows the cells' states.

debugData.name: Streaming grid flight camera
debugData.description: The main camera, so the streaming focus: streamingGrid.ts flies it across the grid (or hovers it on a cell boundary). Watch from the debug camera to see the cells load around it.
